_note: Known / repeat food items with confirmed macros, for quick reuse when logging (no re-estimation needed). Values are per the stated serving.

items.name: Fitness Chocolate breakfast cereal (Osem-Nestlé, 375g box)
items.source: Confirmed 2026-07-31 with a direct label photo, per 100g: 395kcal, 8.6g protein, 69.5g carb (17.5g sugar), 7.2g fat, 198mg sodium — very close to the earlier web-sourced estimate (396/8.6/71.3/7). Fiber still not shown on this label view — kept as an estimate (~6g/100g), flagged for correction if a fuller label panel is checked.

Estimated from typical butter-shortcrust + chocolate-hazelnut-spread rolled cookie macros (~430 kcal/100g). Refine if the user's actual recipe/quantities are ever provided.

items.name: Homemade chicken meatballs (veg-loaded)
items.recipe: 1 kg ground chicken; 1 large onion (chopped, fried); grated sweet potato; grated zucchini/courgette; salt, pepper; a little ketchup; 2 eggs; ~½ cup breadcrumbs. Rest ~1h in fridge, spoon onto pan, fry on medium heat.
items.source: Estimated from recipe; ~2,250 kcal total over ~1,275 g cooked yield → ~176 kcal/100 g. Refine if you weigh the cooked batch.

items.name: Homemade chicken & spelt pasta batch dish (meal prep, w/ tomato paste)
items.recipe: 950g raw chicken breast (stove-grilled) + 750g spelt pasta (dry weight incl. box, to be corrected) + 200g tomato paste + salt/sugar (unspecified qty, excluded) + 2 tbsp olive oil + 1 egg + 1 tbsp cornflour. 30 cherry tomatoes used in cooking but removed before the final dish weigh-in (excluded from macros). Final cooked dish weighed 2000g (3.8kg container+dish minus 1.8kg empty container) — close to the 1986g raw-ingredient sum, so cooking losses/gains roughly cancel.
items.source: Calculated from user-provided ingredient list and container/dish weights 2026-07-24, for a week-ahead meal-prep batch. Pasta weight includes packaging per the user's own flag ('to be changed') — refine once the net dry-pasta weight is known, which would lower kcal/carb/fiber per 100g slightly.
